verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own marketing page describes a built-in campaign agent that plans an entire campaign from a goal. It also describes AI features that rewrite nurture emails per contact and generate blog, social and landing-page content. These count as in-product delegation, but each rests on a single marketing one-liner with no documentation of how the assistant is invoked or what tasks it accepts. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the AI assistant/agent interface and scope of delegable tasks, a general-purpose conversational assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Start from a goal and let campaign agent plan your entire campaign based on brand, audience, and past performance.
Rewrite every nurture email for the specific contact receiving it, using their CRM data, behavior, and live company research.
Create blog posts, social content, and landing pages grounded in your brand voice, audience data, and competitor research.
